situation: Day 14 PK draw taken 5 hours late because the hospital lab centrifuge failed and a replacement had to be borrowed.
ruling: Accepted. A Day 14 PK draw up to 6 hours late is acceptable when caused by documented equipment failure. Log as a minor deviation with the engineer's fault report attached.
reason: Drug levels change by under 10 percent within 6 hours of the Day 14 time point, so the sample remains valid. Equipment failure is outside the site's and patient's control.
